description: Everything Flow's community CLIs and MCP servers do, plus the two things none of them do: real Google Drive ingestion and an honest audio-drama pipeline that closes the loop Flow itself cannot.

tools.name: credits_get
tools.description: Check remaining Flow/Veo credit balance. Required: api-key. Returns the CreditBalance.

params.name: api-key
params.description: Browser API key sent alongside the Bearer token (harvested)

tools.name: flow_workflows_get
tools.description: Fetch a generation workflow's current state. Required: workflowId. Returns the FlowWorkflow.

params.name: workflowId
params.description: Workflow id returned from a generation submission

tools.name: project_contents
tools.description: Fetch a project's full contents: media assets, character/scene entities, and generation workflows -- everything the web UI's Images/Characters/Scenes tabs filter client-side from this one call. Required: input. Returns the ProjectContents.

tools.name: projects_list
tools.description: List the authenticated user's Flow projects. Required: input. Returns array of Project.

tools.name: video_status
tools.description: Poll status for one or more in-flight/queued video generations. Required: names. Returns array of VideoGenerationStatus.

params.name: names
params.description: Generation job identifiers (workflow/operation names) to check

novel_features.name: Beat-to-prompt drafter
novel_features.description: Turn a Scribe recap-script JSON into a ready-to-approve queue of per-segment Flow prompts, each matched to the right seed image automatically.

novel_features.name: Episode import
novel_features.description: Pull a whole episode's assets from two separate Google Drive folders -- Scribe's session output and the images folder -- into a Flow project and draft the prompt queue, in one command.

novel_features.name: Audio mux-back
novel_features.description: Lay your real audio-drama mp3 back over the rendered Flow clips, in the right order and at the right offsets, with one local command.

novel_features.name: Queue credit-affordability check
novel_features.description: See whether a prepared batch of generations fits your remaining Flow credits before you spend a single one.

novel_features.name: Drive import scene auto-tagging
novel_features.description: Pull seed images straight out of a local Google Drive folder into a Flow project, with character tags inferred automatically from filenames (requires --project for character names).

novel_features.name: Batch aggregate status watch
novel_features.description: Check on an entire submitted batch of generations with one command instead of clicking through each one.

novel_features.name: Scene/character/asset gap check
novel_features.description: Find characters missing a reference image and see a media-status breakdown for a project, before you submit a batch.
